name: aria-label
notes: Start with the visible text (Voice Control, Voice Access).

name: aria-labelledby
notes: Mobile has no id reference; merge label and control into one element.

name: aria-describedby
compose: merge the description into the element (mergeDescendants)
notes: A hint is read after a pause; never make the description a second focus stop.

name: aria-live
notes: Deliberate only, as on the web.

name: aria-atomic
notes: Mobile announces the whole live element; nothing to set.

name: aria-busy
swiftui: accessibilityValue with consumer words while busy; announce once on settle
compose: stateDescription while busy; announce once on settle
notes: No busy trait; do not announce intermediate values.

name: aria-expanded
notes: The words for expanded and collapsed come from the consumer.

name: aria-controls
notes: No relationship API; keep the controlled content next in reading order.

name: aria-haspopup
notes: Native Menu and Picker announce it themselves.

name: aria-modal
compose: Dialog / ModalBottomSheet (Material) or semantics { paneTitle } with focus trapped by the window
notes: Never a hand-rolled modal.

name: aria-checked
notes: Mixed state: triStateToggleable on Android; accessibilityValue words on Apple.

name: aria-disabled
notes: Keep it focusable where the web keeps it focusable.

name: aria-invalid
swiftui: accessibilityValue or hint with the consumer's error text; announce on submit
notes: Apple has no invalid trait; the error is always visible text too.

name: aria-orientation
notes: Implied by the layout; adjustable actions use up and down.

name: aria-activedescendant
notes: Move real accessibility focus; there is no active-descendant model.

name: aria-roledescription
swiftui: none (no public API); use the native role
notes: Avoid; prefer the platform's own role names.

name: aria-keyshortcuts
notes: Shown in the iPad keyboard shortcut overlay.

name: alert
notes: Assertive only where the web uses role=alert.

name: application
notes: Not used on mobile.

name: banner
notes: Mobile has no landmarks; the navigation bar is the platform's.

name: grid
swiftui: Grid / LazyVGrid with accessibility children; Table on iPad

name: link
compose: LinkAnnotation in text / Role.Button with link words

name: menubar
notes: iPad menu bar is the system's.

name: navigation
notes: No landmark; navigation is the system's chrome.

name: radio
swiftui: Picker option (native) or .isSelected on a Button

name: radiogroup
swiftui: Picker (native) or accessibilityElement(children: .contain) with a label

name: timer
notes: Never made live, as on the web.

name: tooltip
swiftui: help(_:) on iPad pointer; no touch tooltip
notes: Never the only place information appears.

name: div
notes: Generic; no semantics.

name: dl
swiftui: Grid or VStack of combined pairs
notes: Each term and its value read as one element.

name: form
notes: Form submission is the app's; Lily owns the error summary.

name: mark
swiftui: Text with highlight + accessibility words from the consumer
notes: A highlight is not announced; supply words.

name: table
swiftui: Table on iPad regular width; List on iPhone
notes: Phone tables become lists.

name: time
swiftui: Text(date, style:) with a full spoken form
notes: Format with Foundation or java.time, from the consumer's locale.

name: video
notes: Captions and audio description from the consumer.
